primaryReferences.finding: RSS bookkeeping is asynchronous; smaps is a slower per-process view. PSS divides shared mappings and is a different metric.
memory.current and memory.peak account the cgroup and descendants; scope includes cache/kernel/socket charges. This is not the fixed summed-process-RSS or V8-heap metric.
